title: sivastotravali — s11-v12
question: What would there be where the Lord does not make? What would the knower Śaṅkara destroys be? Thus, ever sheltered in Thee, O Lord of unwasted great power — in this saṃsāra, ceaseless in anguish, I suffer alone.
